rules.rule:
Specialized directives for modules/agent_tools.py (Native Filesystem, Edit & Tool Execution Engine).
DO NOT FLAG: (1) 3-stage resilient string replacement (Exact -> Whitespace-Normalized -> 88% Fuzzy Match) in _resilient_replace(); (2) Lazy diff console initialization and Rich Syntax proxy wrappers; (3) In-memory session tracking (_SESSION_READ_FILES, _SESSION_MODIFIED_FILES) strictly guarded by _is_outside_workspace to prevent ../ path pollution; (4) Incremental line streaming, 8MB size guarding, and accurate total line draining in read_file(); (5) Atomic file writing via PID-tagged tempfiles cleaned up in finally blocks, with an immediate pre-replace os.stat check closing TOCTOU race windows; (6) Direct argv execution bypassing /bin/sh when SHELL_METACHARS are absent; (7) Polled non-blocking reads (select.poll) with 25k-char output cap, process group termination (start_new_session=True, killpg), structured try/finally bounded child reaping (proc.wait(timeout=5)), and explicit pipe closure (proc.stdout.close()) in run_command(); (8) Nanosecond st_mtime_ns and st_size conflict detection in edit_file(); (9) Thread-safe sub-agent recursion guard using contextvars.ContextVar (_SUBAGENT_DEPTH); (10) Pre-gate placement evaluating security gates before any file existence or line-count probing; (11) Symmetric symlink exclusion and workspace containment checks in _search_codebase() across both directory walks and direct file targets; (12) Universal type coercion and alias normalization at the run_tool() dispatcher boundary converting null/scalar values safely to strings; (13) Canonical sys.modules cache invalidation checking __file__ equality to evict dotted package submodules; (14) Strict UTF-8 validation (errors='strict') on existing files in write_file() prior to overwrite.
HUNT FOR: (1) Process group cleanup & signal errors: verify that os.killpg() in run_command() catches ProcessLookupError, PermissionError, and OSError, followed by bounded proc.wait() and pipe FD closure on all timeout and exit paths; (2) TOCTOU mutation windows: verify file modifications re-verify stat metadata immediately before os.replace(); (3) Path containment & symlink symmetry: ensure direct file search roots cannot bypass symlink/containment checks enforced during directory walks; (4) Boundary parameter coercion: ensure LLM-supplied nulls or non-str types cannot escape run_tool() and trigger unhandled TypeErrors in shlex.split() or string methods; (5) Character set & encoding fidelity: ensure strict UTF-8 checking protects non-UTF-8 files from destructive silent overwrites; (6) Workspace session hygiene: verify session tracking sets never store out-of-workspace paths or relative traversal tokens.

Specialized directives for modules/agent_adapters.py (Self-healing parser for SLMs and quantized LLMs).
DO NOT FLAG: (1) Independent multi-format extraction across Hermes, DSML, Mistral, Ling, XML, and JSON without early short-circuiting; (2) Full-fence-only markdown unwrapping in heal_json_args() to prevent truncating internal codeblocks; (3) Scoping XML tag stripping strictly to Pass 4 fallback to preserve legitimate code payloads; (4) Extracting only the first contiguous hunk in _extract_diff_hunk() for surgical edits; (5) Strict @@ -line,count +line,count @@ header validation; (6) Shell escape fidelity in _safe_shell_write() (differentiating single-quoted literals, printf specifiers, and echo -e); (7) Unterminated trailing codeblock recovery (\Z); (8) Linear brace scanning with failed-start skips; (9) Monotonic line-number gutter stripping in _strip_line_number_gutters(); (10) Linear heredoc parsing in _parse_heredoc(); (11) Safe serialization using json.dumps(..., default=str).
HUNT FOR: (1) Structural validation: verify that every extracted tool call strictly validates function name and argument mapping before dispatch; (2) Unbalanced nesting performance: verify that deeply malformed JSON braces or quotes cannot trigger quadratic scanning; (3) Shell parameter safety: ensure unquoted heredocs or shell commands containing unexpanded variables ($VAR) are never coerced into write_file.

Specialized directives for modules/agent_core.py (Core streaming agent loop & SSE engine).
DO NOT FLAG: (1) Post-stream ANSI cursor rewinds clamped to physical viewport (raw_lines < rows - 1) with non-streamed terminal fallback; (2) Calculating fallback prompt tokens from body_messages (including ephemeral_directives); (3) Explicit ALLOWED_MODULES allowlist in run_mod(); (4) Structured return sentinel on max_rounds exhaustion; (5) Bounded 30-file scratchpad FIFO rotation; (6) Envelope-only unwrapping in _heal_tool_args (arguments/args/input/params); (7) Structural denial short-circuiting across string, list, and tuple tool outputs (is_denied); (8) Bounded connection/read timeout tuple (15, min(timeout, 30)); (9) Dedicated _finalize_speed_test() teardown across all exit paths; (10) Ephemeral directive overlays on body_tools['messages']; (11) Lazy runtime loading via _LazyConsole or dynamic Markdown wrappers; (12) In-function deferred imports of requests, agent_ipython, or agent_ui; (13) Thread-local HTTP session pooling (_local_session); (14) Atomic state persistence via PID-tagged tempfiles and os.replace; (15) sys.excepthook overriding with _clean_sigint_handler; (16) Monkeypatching Markdown.elements with CleanCodeBlock.
HUNT FOR: (1) Tool-call/result pairing integrity under exceptions: verify that every assistant tool_calls message is strictly paired with role: tool responses across all error and denial paths to prevent provider 400 errors; (2) Compaction & transcript slicing: verify that messages[:] = prune_history(...) inside the turn loop never slices between an assistant tool_calls message and its tool results; (3) Connection pool recycling & socket drops: ensure requests connection adapters properly recycle sockets back to the pool under remote resets, ChunkedEncodingError, or SIGINT; (4) Terminal stream geometry: verify that RichStreamer and cursor rewinds behave correctly under terminal dimensions and signal interruptions.

Specialized directives for modules/agent_security.py (Zero-Trust Security & Boundary Enforcement Kernel).
DO NOT FLAG: (1) Strict AST inspection of code cells, including blocking open(), os.open(), and io.open() (mutations must route through validated tool gates); (2) Rejecting subscripted callable execution (e.g. func[...]) in AST; (3) Recursive inspection of nested interpreter -c payloads (bash, sh, zsh, python); (4) Fixed-point iterative unwrapping of EXEC_WRAPPERS and VAR=val assignments; (5) Dual TTY requirement (_is_interactive checks both stdin and stdout) to prevent non-interactive hangs; (6) Whitelisting canonical SYSTEM_DEVICES (/dev/null, /dev/tty, /dev/urandom, etc.); (7) Read-only subcommands for systemctl, pacman, and journalctl; (8) Container sandbox healing (/workspace, /app) in resolve_path().
HUNT FOR: (1) Path containment & normalization: verify that target path normalization with expandvars, expanduser, and commonpath strictly prevents traversal escapes via non-existent symlink chains or container healing; (2) Command tokenization & wrapper edge cases: verify that wrapper options consuming values (e.g. timeout -k 5 10s cmd, nice -n 10 cmd, xargs -I {}) cannot hide forbidden binaries, and check for recursion depth exhaustion in deeply nested -c commands; (3) AST inspection evasion: verify that open() or file mutation cannot be reached via indirect builtins reflection (io.FileIO, codecs.open, getattr(__builtins__, 'open')); (4) Authorization gate fail-closed integrity: ensure authorize() strictly denies execution on any unhandled UI/stream exception, closed stdin, or non-interactive environment.

Specialized directives for ai-hook.sh (Dual-Shell Bash >=4.4 + Zsh >=5.0 interactive hook).
DO NOT FLAG: (1) Dual-shell scripting in a single file; (2) eval "$exp" in ai_handle_missing (deliberate shortcut execution pre-validated via bash -n / zsh -n); (3) Terminal clear sequence printf '\x1b[H\x1b[2J'; (4) PID-tagged directory teleportation files .active_cd.$$; (5) Direct /proc/$pid/comm and kill -0 probes; (6) Pure shell IFS= read -r loops in _ai_teleport.
HUNT FOR: Sub-millisecond latency regressions (zero subshells $(...) or external forks in _ai_teleport common path); command-not-found recursion loops in _AI_CNF_ACTIVE; word splitting on unquoted $path, $target, or $exp; ANSI/OSC stripping bypasses in sed sanitization; missing trap cleanup of $lockfile on unexpected exit; path pollution in CDPATH= cd "$path" && pwd -P; and non-numeric PID parsing in lockfile reaper.

Specialized directives for plugins/zed/gpui-bridge.py (JSON-RPC 2.0 stdio bridge for Zed ACP).
DO NOT FLAG: (1) Line-delimited JSON-RPC stdio transport; (2) Per-turn daemon worker threads in handle_session_prompt; (3) Synchronous 60s ACP permission waits on threading.Event(); (4) Advertising loadSession: False and rejecting session/load with -32602; (5) Single-component leading slash normalization (/calc.py -> calc.py); (6) Ephemeral memory injection into transient messages[-1] only; (7) Module-level requests.Session() pooling.
HUNT FOR: Unhandled exceptions dropping RPC error responses (-32601, -32602, -32603) and leaving Zed hanging; permission response parsing leaks in _pending_requests; race conditions in session['lock'] between session/cancel and worker threads; guaranteeing session['busy'] = False in finally blocks; socket leaks on ChunkedEncodingError; orphaned tool calls missing matching role: tool responses; and security gate distinction ensuring critical events (OUT-OF-BOUNDS, PYTHON DANGEROUS OP) always prompt the client.

Specialized directives for modules/agent_ui.py (Terminal UI, Spinners, and Raw Keypress Engine).
DO NOT FLAG: (1) Low-level termios manipulation in _read_fd() using tty.setraw(), termios.tcflush(), and os.read(fd, 1) (required for zero-latency single-key navigation; do NOT suggest input()); (2) Raw ANSI cursor positioning escapes.
HUNT FOR: Unconditionally guaranteed cursor restoration (\033[?25h) and termios attribute restoration (termios.tcsetattr) in finally blocks or signal handlers across all menus and spinners; and thread-safety races where background spinner writes to sys.stderr interleave with stdout output.

Specialized directives for modules/agent_ipython.py (Standalone IPython Kernel & Execution Sandbox).
DO NOT FLAG: (1) Dynamic execution of Python code in-process; (2) Custom AST validation hooks.
HUNT FOR: Evasion of inspect_ast_safety via obfuscated imports (__import__, getattr, importlib); subprocess pipe buffer deadlocks in shell tool calls; thread leaks in cell timeout handlers; and boundary escapes in safe_open() or safe_listdir() bypassing workspace realpath validation.

Specialized directives for modules/agent_sessions.py (SQLite Session, Checkpoints & Sub-Agent Worktrees).
DO NOT FLAG: (1) SQLite URI read-only connections; (2) Automated git worktree branching for sub-agents.
HUNT FOR: SQLite database locked errors (missing busy_timeout); unclosed connection handles during exceptions; race conditions when sweeping dead session locks (.active_sessions); and orphaned git worktrees when sub-agents crash or fail to merge.

Specialized directives for modules/agent_tui_async.py (Async Background Services & IPC Hub).
DO NOT FLAG: (1) uvloop event loop usage; (2) Unix domain sockets for sub-agent communication.
HUNT FOR: Orphaned Unix domain sockets in /tmp/*.sock failing to unlink on shutdown or unhandled exception; unhandled asyncio.CancelledError causing state corruption; and message framing errors in stream communication.

Specialized directives for tools/system/* (System Diagnostics & Host Inspection Utilities).
DO NOT FLAG: (1) Direct inspection of /proc, /sys/class/hwmon, and /var/log; (2) Read-only execution of journalctl, systemctl list-units, ss -tulnpH, pacman -Qm, checkupdates, or df; (3) Semantic IP masking in security-audit (replacing private IPs with tokens like [localhost] or [private-ip] is an intentional privacy layer).
HUNT FOR: E2BIG command line argument overflows (large payloads like PKGBUILDs or diffs must use stdin or tempfiles, not argv); flawed script directory resolution using raw dirname "$0" instead of cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd -P; dynamic execution via source "$ENV_PATH" or source .env (must be parsed statically); bad indirect variable expansion ${!var} under set -u; and unquoted git commit -m "$msg" calls missing -- termination.

Specialized directives for plugin protocol bridges (DeepSeek Harness, PyCode, Zed).
DO NOT FLAG: (1) Stdio streaming RPC protocols; (2) Deferred module imports.
HUNT FOR: Pipe buffer deadlocks when writing JSON chunks to stdout; unhandled socket disconnection errors; and missing role: tool response records when tool calls are aborted or declined.

Global Py-Agent Python Policy:
DO NOT FLAG: (1) Zero-daemon architecture (strict Python stdlib + SQLite + requests + rich; do NOT suggest Redis, Docker, Celery, or vector databases); (2) ANSI control escapes for formatting terminal output.
HUNT FOR: Cursor restoration (\033[?25h) missing in finally blocks; subprocess calls using shell=True without shlex.quote; unbounded file reads without size guards (preventing OOM); and unhandled SIGINT leading to unclean exits.

Global Py-Agent Shell Policy:
DO NOT FLAG: (1) POSIX shell scripts using portable idioms.
HUNT FOR: Unquoted variable expansions causing word splitting on paths with spaces; unhandled exit codes under set -e; background process leaks ($!) without EXIT traps; and unsafe sourcing of user-writable environment files.
